name: bermuda-tax
description: Start here for any Bermuda tax question in 2026. Bermuda has no personal income tax, no VAT, GST or sales tax, no capital gains tax and no withholding tax on dividends, interest or royalties. This skill says so plainly and covers what Bermuda does charge outside payroll and corporate income tax, namely customs import duty under the 2026 tariff, duty-free allowances, stamp duty on land transfers, leases and other documents, and land tax on annual rental value and the 1.25% foreign currency purchase tax, and routes payroll tax, social insurance, corporate income tax and company formation to their own skills. Trigger phrases include Bermuda tax, Bermuda income tax, Bermuda VAT, Bermuda customs duty, Bermuda stamp duty, land tax.
